function.name: execute_bash

content:
cat > /tmp/driver.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
extern int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *, size_t);
int main(int argc, char **argv){
  if(argc<2) return 2;
  FILE *f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); if(!f) return 3;
  fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET);
  unsigned char *b=malloc(n?n:1); fread(b,1,n,f); fclose(f);
  int r=LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(b,(size_t)n); free(b); return r;
}
EOF



cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/test && gcc -g -O0 -fsanitize=address,undefined -I. fuzz.c /tmp/driver.c -o /tmp/fuzz_mongoose && /tmp/fuzz_mongoose /workspace/candidate.bin > /tmp/run.out 2>/tmp/run.err; rc=$?; echo rc=$rc; grep -A80 -B5 "ERROR\|runtime error" /tmp/run.err | head -160 || head -120 /tmp/run.err
rc=1
